q2_otherBodySchemasNestingARosterUnit.answer: None. In src/lib/api the only roster-unit schema is CampaignRosterUnitSchema (securitySchemas.ts:83-91); its only use is CampaignAuthoritativeStateSchema.rosterUnits (:113), whose only use is CoopCampaignRegistrationSchema.state (:127), whose only use is CreateMultiplayerMatchBodySchema.coopCampaign (:151). The other exported body schemas, TokenIssueBodySchema (:17-34) and UnlockIdentityBodySchema (:36-40), nest no roster unit; MatchUnitBootstrapEntrySchema (:58-69) is a tactical bootstrap entry, not ICampaignRosterUnit. The three importers of securitySchemas are src/pages/api/multiplayer/auth/token.ts:34, src/pages/api/multiplayer/matches/index.ts:33 and src/pages/api/vault/identity/unlock.ts:19 (grep). So one field on CampaignRosterUnitSchema covers every place src/lib/api parses a roster unit.
q2_otherBodySchemasNestingARosterUnit.outsideOwnershipObservation: src/types/campaign/campaignSyncSchemas.ts:33-37 (rosterUnitSchema, a plain z.object with unitId, designation, status; zod ^4.3.6 per package.json:269) is used for intent recoveredUnit (:89) and Protocol.ts:492 rosterChanges. q3_reValidationOrStrippingAfterParseBody.answer: Nothing downstream strips or refuses sourceVersion once parseBody accepts it. parseBody returns result.data (security.ts:65), which for a strict zod object keeps every declared key. The route copies body.coopCampaign into meta (index.ts:239) and hands body.coopCampaign.state to CampaignHostRegistry.register (:325-331). register re-checks the snapshot with parseCampaignCoopSnapshot (CampaignHostRegistry.ts:266-275), which inspects unitId/unitSource/unitRef/forceUnits only and returns the same state object (campaignCoopSnapshot.ts:42-77), then passes initialState: snapshot.state to CampaignMatchHost (CampaignHostRegistry.ts:292), which stores it as its state (CampaignMatchHost.ts:150). commitCoopCampaignAuthority (index.ts:252-275) reads the persisted campaign record, not the body state. The green route row measures host.getState() after the 201.

q4_routeHarness.answer: Yes. src/__tests__/unit/api/multiplayerCoopCreationCheckpoint.test.ts:85-110 (mockReqRes over a plain req/res pair, handler imported at :40, auth mocked at :51-64, temp SQLite initialised per test at :199-206, campaign persisted with saveCampaign at :152) and src/__tests__/unit/api/multiplayerMatchesFog.test.ts:40-71 (same pair, no database) both drive the route handler.
